title: Task lifecycle, claim lease and result report
description: One task is submitted once, claimed at most once per lease generation, and settled by exactly one accepted report. Leases are optimistic: every claim increments generation, and a heartbeat or report carrying an older generation is rejected as lease_lost rather than silently applied. Expiry is not permission to re-run: for non-idempotent work an expired lease moves the task to outcome_unknown and waits for an explicit reconciliation, because a worker that lost the lease may already have caused the side effect. Uploaded artifacts without an accepted report are likewise reconciled, and a duplicate report is an idempotent no-op that returns the first accepted outcome.

kind.description: Closed set of executable work kinds. A new kind is a contract change, not a free-form string.

idempotent.description: Declared by the submitting service and enforced by the core. Only idempotent work may be reclaimed automatically after lease expiry.

state.description: submitted: durable and claimable. leased: a live worker holds a generation. cancel_requested: cancel recorded, worker must stop and report. outcome_unknown: side effect may have happened; needs reconciliation, never auto-run. succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired: terminal.

submittedBy.description: Authenticated principal that submitted the task; the only principal allowed to cancel it or reconcile its unknown outcome.

paramsDigest.description: sha256 of the stored parameters. Parameters themselves stay server-side; a caller sees only this digest.

generation.description: Monotonic claim generation. Zero before the first claim, incremented by each successful claim, never reused.

deadline.description: Absolute lease deadline of the current generation. A report or heartbeat after it is stale.

workerID.description: Opaque worker identity for this claim. The same worker re-claiming gets a new generation; it never extends the old one implicitly.

digest.description: sha256 of artifact content. The core records it and never re-derives it from a worker-supplied string.

resultDigest.description: Digest of the uploaded result payload, when the task produced one. A report naming a digest the core never stored fails reconciliation instead of inventing a result.

duplicate.description: Set by the core on the response when this report matched an already accepted one. The stored outcome is returned unchanged.
